 Order

1. The case of the petitioner is that his land in Survey No.7 measuring 1 acre 13 guntas of Chapparadahalli Village, Kundana Hobli, Devanahalli Taluk, Bangalore Rural District, was acquired for the purpose of respondent no.2/Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board.

Further,
respondent no.3 has passed a general award and deposited the compensation in the Reference Court.
He prays that consent award be passed in respect of the said land.

sentences.text: 2. The learned counsel appearing for the respondents submit that they have no objection to pass a consent award provided the petitioner produces all the relevant documents to show that he is the owner of the property.

3. Under similar circumstances, this Court in umpteen number of cases has permitted the land losers to claim compensation as per the consent award upon establishing the fact that they are the owners of the property.
There is NC: 2024:KHC:19022 no reason why a similar order should not be passed in the instant case also.
